permissions.window.overlay: to draw the weather card in a corner of your pane

permissions.net:geocoding-api.open-meteo.com: to find the latitude and longitude of the place you set

permissions.net:api.open-meteo.com: to read the current weather and the next hours for that place

permissions.ai.ask: to write a one-line summary of the coming hours, only when you turn it on (Tilefold asks before anything is sent)
